issue_request: FHIR-17184 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core narrative issue raised for STU3 asking for guidance that externally looked-up referenced-resource content can legitimately appear in Narrative.status generated or extensions narrative.
initial_application: SVN revision 14336, represented by git commit c07a35048a83bbc4670f12f255de95511f59e388, applied the issue by adding guidance to source/narrative.html and source/references.html.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps Narrative active as a special datatype/type page and marks it normative. source/references.html contains the linked reference-rendering write-up and explicitly says narrative derived from other resources is still regarded as generated for Narrative.status. Earlier FHIR-9826/FHIR-17463 and the 2016 Zulip discussion support the same interpretation; no later conflicting evidence was found.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current source already implements the requested clarification through the narrative page and linked reference-rendering section.
